remarks: Welcome home! This townhouse property is income regulated. Buyer cannot own another property, now or within the last 3 years. This unit must be owner occupied - no investors!  The income limit system is as follows: *LOW (80%) Income Limit: 1 person/ $83,300. 2 person/ $95,200. 3 person/ $107,050. 4 person/ $118,950. 5 person/ $128,500. 6 person/ $138,000. 7 person/ $17,500  All buyers will need to verify these limits upon obtaining a pre qualification letter from lender. The offer cannot exceed the set list price (max sales price=$131,200). The buyer will be reviewed for qualification/ final acceptance through CT Housing Partners, upon acceptance of offer.  This 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath unit is tucked away, quietly and offers an array of amenities - recreational park & outdoor grilling nearby! 3 - in wall air conditioning units are included. Tankless hot water heater, electric range, washer & dryer in unit. 1 assigned parking space w/ additional visitor parking available.
